categories.main_business_segments: Asia Plastic Recycling Holding Limited primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of Ethylene-Vinyl Acetate (EVA) foam materials. Its product portfolio includes shoe soles, luggage liners, general sheets, rubber foam, floor mats, and other specialized sheets. The company also focuses on recycling waste plastics and scrap materials for reuse in production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes EVA foam technology involving physical or chemical cross-linking foaming processes to produce lightweight, cushioning, sound-absorbing, and insulating plastic materials. It has proprietary recycling and reprocessing techniques for waste plastics and EVA scrap, enabling the production of recycled EVA foam compounds. The production process is highly integrated and automated, covering recycling, pelletizing, compounding, foaming, and post-processing stages, supported by in-house equipment design and continuous R&D improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers in the footwear and luggage industries, which together account for about 70% of the downstream market. Other customers include sectors such as toys, sports goods, construction materials, electronics packaging, automotive interiors, and emerging fields. The company serves mainly industrial clients requiring EVA foam materials for various applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its main production base in Fujian Province, specifically Jinjiang City, a major footwear manufacturing hub. Sales focus on the Chinese domestic market, especially the eastern and southern coastal provinces. Although the company does not directly export, some products reach international markets through downstream trading partners. The holding company is registered in the Cayman Islands, with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Asia Plastic Recycling Holding Limited operates mainly in the midstream segment of the EVA foam supply chain, converting raw EVA and recycled plastics into foam materials. It sources raw materials including virgin EVA, LDPE, and recycled plastics from suppliers and sells finished foam products to downstream manufacturers in footwear, luggage, and other industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in developing new environmentally friendly EVA foam materials, including flame-retardant, biodegradable, anti-static, antibacterial, and high-performance composites. It invests in automation and process improvements to enhance production efficiency and product quality. Strategic collaborations with academic institutions and technology centers support innovation, while expanding applications into emerging sectors such as electronics, automotive, and construction materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of EVA foam products and related materials. The company also derives income from leasing and managing industrial park facilities under its 'Sansda Shoe Textile Park' project, diversifying revenue streams beyond core manufacturing operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the Chinese EVA foam market with approximately 5% market share, ranking first domestically. Competitors include numerous small and medium-sized manufacturers, with a few large-scale players such as Jinjiang Chengchang Shoe Material Co., Fujian Quanzhou Sansheng Rubber & Plastic Foam Shoe Material Co., and Shantou Economic Zone Jianxin Plastic Co. The company's proprietary recycling technology, integrated production scale, and product quality provide significant competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$817 million, a 5.87% increase from 2023. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss after tax of about NT$414 million, slightly improved from the previous year. Total assets grew by 37.55% to NT$6.3 billion, driven by capital expenditures in industrial park development. The company’s liabilities increased significantly due to new borrowings for expansion projects. R&D expenses represent around 2.5% of revenue, reflecting ongoing innovation efforts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Asia Plastic Recycling emphasizes its advanced recycling technology that enables efficient reuse of waste plastics and EVA scrap, reducing raw material costs and environmental impact. Its vertically integrated and automated production process ensures high product quality, consistency, and cost competitiveness. The company offers a broad and innovative product range tailored to diverse applications, supported by strong R&D capabilities and strategic industry collaborations, positioning it as a sustainable and technologically advanced EVA foam supplier.
